No Aquatic Form yet? Take A Lesson to Learn from him too: it also goes to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Dendrite Starblaze|r, and its Trial of the Lake (the Aquatic Form guide) is in the same Moonglade.

Cast Teleport: Moonglade. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Dendrite Starblaze|r stands upstairs in his building in Nighthaven: go up inside, the arrow cannot tell the floors apart. Learn the flight path there if you do not have it.

The Great Cat Spirit (Night Elves) waits on the hill above the bridge in southern Moonglade; the |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Avatar of Saeyleenan|r (Skyborne) stands on high ground past the twin bridges, south-west of Nighthaven: climb up to it. The relics lie in the Stormrage Barrow Dens east of the lake: leave your form and click the statue at the den's entrance for a short stealth (five minutes), then go deep into the cave and over the bridge. Enraged spirits guard the relics and attack anything they see: stay in the statue's stealth and keep moving. Each relic is a small orb beside a cat statue in an alcove: the Fang and the Claw have one spot each, the Silent Shadow two, and it is the one players camp. A relic shows as unusable while another player loots it: wait a moment and try again. Stealth gone? Walk back to the entrance statue for more.

Cast Teleport: Moonglade to land by |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Dendrite Starblaze|r in Nighthaven (nobody on Zephras Isle takes the Skyborne quest), then take |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bunthen Plainswind|r's flight to Thunder Bluff. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Dendrite Starblaze|r stands upstairs in his building: go up inside, the arrow cannot tell the floors apart.
Turn in Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
Turn in Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Turak Runetotem|r on Elder Rise teaches you Cat Form.
Turn in To Thunder Bluff (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Turak Runetotem|r: Cat Form)

At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tiza Battleforge|r, upstairs in the |cOXP_PICK_Hall of Mysteries|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Mystic Ward|r, gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Tome of Valor|r. Right-click it: it sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Duthorian Rall|r in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Take the Deeprun Tram from Ironforge to Stormwind.
Turn in The Tome of Valor
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Duthorian Rall|r stands in the Cathedral of Light. Humans get the |cOXP_LOOT_Tome of Valor|r from him. Right-click the book to start its quest and hand it straight back to him.
Turn in The Tome of Valor
Accept The Tome of Valor (Right-click the |cOXP_LOOT_Tome of Valor|r)
Turn in The Tome of Valor

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Daphne Stilwell|r's farmhouse stands on the south-west coast of Westfall, south of Moonbrook: take the path that runs south beside the Deadmines' back exit. When you take her quest, she walks from her orchard to the house and three waves of Defias Raiders (level 17-18) attack: three, then four, then five. Fight close to her so they do not swarm her, and heal her when she drops. You get time to eat and drink between waves, and she heals to full. If you or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Daphne Stilwell|r die, the quest fails: abandon it and take it again from her (she is back five minutes after dying). Players find it hard alone before about 24.
Turn in The Tome of Valor
Finish The Tome of Valor: Protect Daphne Stilwell (Protect |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Daphne Stilwell|r: three waves)
Turn in The Tome of Valor
Back to the Cathedral of Light: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Duthorian Rall|r gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Bastion of Stormwind|r shield and teaches you Sense Undead.
Turn in The Tome of Valor (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Duthorian Rall|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Bastion of Stormwind|r, Sense Undead)
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jordan Stilwell|r works outside the gates of Ironforge, not inside. He gives you |cOXP_LOOT_Jordan's Weapon Notes|r: four parts, in any order. Keep the notes.
Turn in The Test of Righteousness
|cOXP_ENEMY_Bailor Stonehand|r is downstairs in the house of Thelsamar that has a tailoring merchant outside. His quest only opens once you hold Jordan's.

The crate of ore sits outdoors in the middle of the Mo'grosh ogre camp in north-east Loch Modan, beside a big tree and a broken wagon, between the caves. The camp holds about fifteen Mo'grosh ogres, elite (level 18-19), who knock you down and come back after five minutes: grouping up is encouraged; at 20-22 it needs a group of about three. The crate is back two seconds after each loot, so every paladin in the group gets one.
|cOXP_ENEMY_Bailor Stonehand|r turns the ore into |cOXP_LOOT_Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment|r, the part Jordan wants.

Deadmines is a group of five under Moonbrook; the instance portal is at the bottom of the Moonbrook mine. The Goblin Woodcarvers (elite, level 18-19) in the mast room with Sneed drop the lumber every time.

Shadowfang Keep is a dungeon for a group of five in the low to mid 20s, in southern Silverpine Forest, Horde land: a long trip for the Alliance, through the Wetlands, Arathi and Hillsbrad. The hammer lies on a crate across from the horses in the stables, early in the dungeon, at the far end of the courtyard before the ramp up; it is back five minutes after someone takes it.
|cOXP_ENEMY_Thundris Windweaver|r is in Auberdine. Take his quest before you hunt naga: the Kor Gem never drops without it.

The Blackfathom naga in the flooded passages around the Blackfathom Deeps entrance, on Ashenvale's north-west coast, drop the |cOXP_LOOT_Corrupted Kor Gem|r: Tide Priestesses (level 20-21), Oracles (21-22) and Sea Witches (23-24), one in two. You do not need to enter the instance. All are elite: grouping up is encouraged; players solo them one at a time, with difficulty. They heal themselves, run for help at low health, satyrs stand near some, and the Sea Witches cast Frost Nova up close. Some players report no drop while in a raid group.
Back to |cOXP_ENEMY_Thundris Windweaver|r in Auberdine: he purifies the gem.
Turn in Seeking the Kor Gem
Bring the four parts to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jordan Stilwell|r outside Ironforge. Accept his last quest and wait by him while he forges the mace at his anvil.
Turn in The Test of Righteousness
Turn in The Test of Righteousness (|cOXP_LOOT_Verigan's Fist|r)

At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Master Mathias Shaw|r, upstairs in the SI:7 building in |cOXP_PICK_Old Town|r, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Agent Kearnen|r in Westfall. This chain is how you learn Poisons on Forever, so do not skip it.

Kearnen hides stealthed against the west side of a big tree with two small trees in front of it, just north of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Klaven Mortwake|r's Defias tower in the far east of Westfall, by the Duskwood border. Read |cOXP_LOOT_Kearnen's Journal|r for the tower's layout if you like.
Turn in Mathias and the Defias

Get the key first. The |cOXP_ENEMY_Malformed Defias Drone|r (level 23, not elite) starts at the tower entrance and walks a loop around the outside; it is the spiky-haired one trailing yellow sparkles. Stealth up and Pick Pocket it from behind: it always has the key. It hits hard: if stealth breaks, Sprint away. Watch for the pair of Defias Drones that also patrol.

Sneak up the tower. Defias Tower Patrollers (23) and Sentries (24) guard the floors; an Ambush with a dagger kills them outright if you would rather clear them. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Klaven Mortwake|r, a level 26 elite, waits on the top floor: Sap him, or bring a friend. The |cOXP_PICK_Duskwood Chest|r beside his desk needs Lockpicking of about 70-75 (practise on the boxes at Alther's Mill in Redridge first). A trick: while the Sentries are away, jump from the chair to the lamp to the bookshelf above the chest, step out of stealth and open the chest from there. Opening it poisons you with the Touch of Zanzil, which stops your stealth for a while and lets the drone see you; that is why the key comes first. Then get out.
Klaven Mortwake's Journal: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Klaven Mortwake's Journal|r: the |cOXP_PICK_Duskwood Chest|r, top floor)

Head north through Elwynn to Stormwind; Mathias Shaw is upstairs in SI:7. He teaches Poisons and gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Thistle Tea|r recipe. Poisons are made, not bought: each batch of Instant Poison takes a |cOXP_LOOT_Dust of Decay|r and an |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Vial|r, which |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jasper Fel|r and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sloan McCoy|r sell in |cOXP_PICK_Old Town|r next to SI:7. Buy a stack of each, open Poisons from your spellbook to make them, then use a poison on your weapon.
Turn in Klaven's Tower (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Master Mathias Shaw|r: Poisons)

The Touch of Zanzil still sits on you. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Doc Mixilpixil|r works in the cellar of the SI:7 building: the stairs down are under the stairs to the upper floor, behind |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jasper Fel|r. Target him and type /lay (nothing after it) to be examined, then wait. If he does nothing, abandon the quest, take it again and wait until he asks you to lie down.
Turn in The Touch of Zanzil
Finish The Touch of Zanzil: Diagnosis Complete (/lay with the Doc targeted)
Turn in The Touch of Zanzil

All four are in Stormwind. |cOXP_LOOT_Simple Wildflowers|r: Bernard or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Felicia Gump|r's flower shop by the |cOXP_PICK_Trade District|r canal. A |cOXP_LOOT_Leaded Vial|r: many general goods and alchemy vendors (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Keldric Boucher|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jasper Fel|r and others). A |cOXP_LOOT_Bronze Tube|r: the Auction House in the |cOXP_PICK_Trade District|r; the engineering suppliers keep only one and are nearly always sold out, and an engineer can make one. The |cOXP_LOOT_Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread|r lies on the floor beside the left end of the counter in |cOXP_PICK_The Finest Thread|r, the tailor's shop on the canals; you can only pick it up with this quest. If you skip the cure, an |cOXP_LOOT_Anti-Venom|r (First Aid) or a druid's Cure Poison also clears the Touch of Zanzil.
Bronze Tube: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Bronze Tube|r: the Auction House)
Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread: 1
Turn in The Touch of Zanzil (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Doc Mixilpixil|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Eau de Mixilpixil|r)
At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Lago Blackwrench|r, the warlock trainer in Ironforge's |cOXP_PICK_Forlorn Cavern|r, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r in Stormwind. Take the Deeprun Tram.

At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r, in the cellar of the |cOXP_PICK_Slaughtered Lamb|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Mage Quarter|r, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Takar the Seer|r in the Barrens: a long trip for the Alliance. Take the boat from Menethil Harbor to Theramore and head west through Dustwallow Marsh, or the boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Takar the Seer|r camps at a tent with a campfire just north-east of Camp Taurajo, by a fork in the road: Horde ground, so come in from the east and keep clear of the Taurajo guards. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Doan Karhan|r beside him starts the |cOXP_LOOT_Orb of Soran'ruk|r. Takar offers both branches: take both.

Ordil'Aran lies in north-west Ashenvale, north of Astranaar along the road toward Darkshore. About twenty Dark Strand cultists hold the ruins around the great tree: keep to the outer wall, and click the Heartswood from as far away as it lets you. It is turned in to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r, not to Takar.

The house stands alone in the trees of north-western Ashenvale, north-west of Ordil'Aran and well north of Maestra's Post: do it on the same trip as the Heartswood. Take the |cOXP_LOOT_Unlit Torch|r from the table outside, light it at a campfire (a |cOXP_PICK_Basic Campfire|r of your own, or Talen's fire on Zoram Strand), and go straight back: the |cOXP_LOOT_Burning Torch|r burns out after five minutes, so a fire of your own beside the house is quickest. Without it the figure in the house stops you. The figurine is upstairs.
Unlit Torch: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Unlit Torch|r, on the table outside)

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r with the Heartswood. He hands you the |cOXP_LOOT_Heartswood Core|r: take the stairs behind him down to the crypt; part way along the lowest corridor a side stair on the left leads to the room with the purple circle. Stand on it and use the core. Summon your voidwalker first and keep the succubus (level 20, not elite) on the circle, or the guards may kill her and the kill does not count. If she wins, use the core again; keep it, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r takes it back.
Use Heartswood Core (|cOXP_LOOT_Heartswood Core|r, on the circle in the crypt)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r: Summon Succubus)

Give Gakin the figurine, then use the |cOXP_LOOT_Wooden Figurine|r at the middle of the same circle and defeat the incubus it calls (level 20, not elite; it can charm you) with your voidwalker tanking. Keep the figurine: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r takes it back.
Kill Summoned Incubus: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Summoned Incubus|r, at the circle in the crypt)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gakin the Darkbinder|r: Summon Incubus)
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Wu Shen|r, beside |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ilsa Corbin|r in the warrior trainers' building of |cOXP_PICK_Old Town|r, sends you to Yorus Barleybrew in Redridge.
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Kelv Sternhammer|r, the warrior trainer of Ironforge, sends you to Yorus Barleybrew in Redridge.
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Darnath Bladesinger|r, the warrior trainer of Darnassus, sends you to Yorus Barleybrew in Redridge.

Yorus Barleybrew sits in the inn at Lakeshire. His test is timed: before you take it, clear the Redridge gnolls on the path to the Rethban Caverns in the hills north-west of Lakeshire, including the two on the rock by the cave mouth (climb it from its right side).

You have one hour, and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Yorus Barleybrew|r's Barleybrew Scalder leaves you drunk for 8-10 minutes. Run north-west into the Rethban Caverns, keeping close to the cliff wall to miss most gnoll packs, and go in as far as the first fork; then come back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Yorus Barleybrew|r (from the ridge you can jump down into Lakeshire). Dying and releasing your spirit fails the quest: abandon it and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Yorus Barleybrew|r gives it again.
Finish The Rethban Gauntlet: Enter the Rethban Caverns (Enter the Rethban Caverns and come back)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Furen Longbeard|r works in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. He takes the |cOXP_LOOT_Cask of Scalder|r (lost it? abandon the quest and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Yorus Barleybrew|r gives a new one) and gives you |cOXP_LOOT_Furen's Favor|r, a shield; Fire Hardened Mail is a level 28 quest, with |cOXP_LOOT_Furen's Instructions|r listing what it needs.
You need 50 fangs. The Leech Stalkers and Cave Stalkers (level 21-22) crawl in the middle of the Wetlands, north of Dun Algaz; every one drops a fang. They poison; back in 5 minutes.

The chimaeras live south-west of Sun Rock Retreat in the Charred Vale; the guide waits for level 26 first. You need 12 Charred Horns from the Fledgling (level 25-27) and Young Chimaeras (23-25), four kills in five, and the |cOXP_LOOT_Galvanized Horn|r from the |cOXP_ENEMY_Chimaera Matriarch|r (28, the big one), also four in five. Only three Fledglings, two Young and one Matriarch live there, each back in 5 minutes, so expect to wait. Fledglings and the Matriarch spit Corrosive Poison, the Young cast Lightning Bolt. Alliance: fly to Stonetalon Peak and head south.
Charred Horn: 12 (|cOXP_LOOT_Charred Horn|r, from the young chimaeras)
Galvanized Horn: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Galvanized Horn|r, from the |cOXP_ENEMY_Chimaera Matriarch|r)

Roogug is an elite quilboar (level 28) inside Razorfen Kraul, the dungeon at the south end of the Barrens; a five-player dungeon: needs a group of five, and his guards come with him. Inside take the left path at the first fork, cross the root bridge, go past the big empty cauldron: he is in a dead end on the right, with about ten elites on the way. He casts Lightning Bolt and calls Earth Rumblers. The vial always drops.
Vial of Phlogiston: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Vial of Phlogiston|r, from Roogug)

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Furen Longbeard|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Dwarven District|r for the hauberk. He then sends you to the smith of your race; the other two smiths' pieces are open to you as well: talk to them directly.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Grimand Elmore|r keeps the weapon shop in the north-west of the |cOXP_PICK_Dwarven District|r, a short walk from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Furen Longbeard|r. He wants 20 Burning Blood and the |cOXP_LOOT_Burning Rock|r.

The Nightbane worgen of Duskwood (Dark Runners, Vile Fangs, Shadow Weavers, Worgen and Tainted Ones, level 26-31) south and west of Darkshire drop the Burning Blood four kills in five. The Tainted Ones poison and howl; Vile Fangs cause Infected Wound.
Burning Blood: 20 (Burning Blood, from the Nightbane worgen)

|cOXP_ENEMY_Gutspill|r (level 32, not elite) carries the |cOXP_LOOT_Burning Rock|r, four kills in five; the guide waits for level 30 first. He walks between the inside and the mouth of the Roland's Doom mine south-east of Darkshire, so wait at the entrance and pull him outside. He poisons and howls.
Mathiel works on the south side of the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. He wants 20 Sunscorched Shells.

The shells lie on the ground under the wyvern nests at Highperch in western Thousand Needles, deeper into the gorge. Only nine exist and each returns 3 minutes after you pick it, so you will wait; some shell-like things there cannot be looted. Highperch Wyverns (level 28-31) guard them and sometimes come several at once.
Ride the Deeprun Tram from Stormwind to Ironforge. Klockmort Spannerspan, a gnome smith, works in |cOXP_PICK_Tinker Town|r near the engineering trainers. He wants 20 |cOXP_LOOT_Searing Coral|r.

The Iron Coral grows on the sea floor just south of Menethil Harbor, by the murloc huts and a wrecked boat: eight there and two south-east of the harbor, each back in 3 minutes, so you will wait for respawns to reach 20. The murlocs can net you underwater: watch your breath, and a |cOXP_LOOT_Draught of Water Breathing|r removes the risk.
Searing Coral: 20 (|cOXP_LOOT_Searing Coral|r, from Iron Coral)

Climb to the top of the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. The Dark Strand Fanatics around it are easy (level 16-17), but four Dark Strand Voidcallers (level 28-29) stand in the tower on the way to the orb: each calls a voidwalker and casts Shadow Bolt from range. At 22-25 bring a friend or two, pull them one at a time and step behind a wall so they have to come to you. Loot the Strange Orb at the top: it gives you the Althalaxx Orb; right-click it to start the quest. Keep the orb in your bags until the |cOXP_PICK_Spear of Mannoroth|r: three later quests need it.
Accept A Strange Artifact (Strange Orb atop the Tower of Althalaxx: right-click the Althalaxx Orb it gives)
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Delgren the Purifier|r stands at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, south of the Darkshore road. He sends you to Stormwind with the orb.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Katherine the Pure|r stands in the Cathedral of Light; she sends you to a warlock for a second opinion.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ursula Deline|r, the warlock trainer, is in the |cOXP_PICK_Mage Quarter|r's warlock sanctum, down in the |cOXP_PICK_Slaughtered Lamb|r's cellar. She wants 14 |cOXP_LOOT_Summoner's Salt|r to read the orb.

The Blackrock Summoners, Champions and Trackers (level 22-25, not elite) camp in the north-west of Redridge and drop the |cOXP_LOOT_Summoner's Salt|r; you need 14. Two elite Blackrock Shadowcasters (22-23) stand at the cave mouth at the camp's east end: pull around them. The Blackrock camps east of Lakeshire drop the salt too, but their Shadowcasters, Sentries and Hunters are elite (level 21-24), and so is |cOXP_ENEMY_Gath'Ilzogg|r (26): stay in the north-west.

Demon Fall Canyon is in south-east Ashenvale, east of Splintertree Post (a Horde camp: go round it). The Mannoroc Lashers, Searing Infernals, Felguards and Legion Hounds (level 29-30, not elite) drop the Motes of Mannoroth; you need 12. Below about 27 they are hard alone: come with a second player or later. Felguards knock you down, Lashers cast Shadow Bolt and Immolate, Infernals keep a fire shield up. They respawn in five minutes.

The |cOXP_PICK_Spear of Mannoroth|r stands at the east end of Demon Fall Canyon. Hand in the motes at the spear with the Althalaxx Orb in your bags: the orb shatters, and the |cOXP_PICK_Shattered Orb|r beside it starts the last quest.
Turn in It Must Be Destroyed
Accept Return to Delgren (from the |cOXP_PICK_Shattered Orb|r)
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Delgren the Purifier|r at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, across the whole zone.
Turn in Return to Delgren (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Delgren the Purifier|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Cloak of the Divine Storm|r)

The |cOXP_PICK_Dead Drop|r is a chest in a house just outside Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine, south of Shadowfang Keep. Open it and read C's note: the job has to be done alone, out of any group.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Veenix|r, a goblin friendly to both factions, stands among the Venture Co. in the Windshear Crag, east Stonetalon, a short way north-east of Sun Rock Retreat. Horde fly to Sun Rock Retreat; Alliance to Stonetalon Peak. He wants a |cOXP_LOOT_Venture Co. Work Order|r before he hands over explosives: the Venture Co. Loggers (level 18) working around him carry them in their pockets. Stealth up behind one and Pick Pocket it; killing them does not give it.

Go in alone and use the |cOXP_LOOT_Breaching Charge|r at the courtyard gate. Players also report a freed prisoner opening the courtyard door for you: if you die while he is opening it, stay dead until it is open; it stays open once you release. If you know Vanish, bring |cOXP_LOOT_Flash Powder|r and check its cooldown before entering; keep it ready for a failed approach. A chest sits in the tunnel: do not open it. Cast Detect Traps near it and walk up close; that is the Rite of Cunning (it comes back after 5 minutes). Opening the chest calls Milton, an elite rogue of about level 32. Through the tunnel lies Ravenholdt Manor: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Fahrad|r is upstairs inside. Quick and quiet, says |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Myrokos Silentform|r. Pick the pockets of the level 20-21 Syndicate Rogues, Shadow Mages and Watchmen on your way: they carry Syndicate Emblems for the guards' repeatable reputation quest.

Turn in What's the Big Idea?

Back to Zardeth once more: he offers warlocks a reward, which his imp |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zggi|r, standing beside him, hands over.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bink|r teaches mages in Ironforge's |cOXP_PICK_Mystic Ward|r. Take the Deeprun Tram from |cOXP_PICK_Tinker Town|r to Stormwind afterwards.

Morganth (level 26 elite) stands across the top floor: you do not need him, keep to the left edge of the ramp so he stays put. The book is back two seconds after anyone takes it. Turn in Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic

Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood: the six Carrion Recluses (level 25-26, green, Paralyzing Poison) walk the graves, the central statue and the riverbank, and every one drops a silk; they come back after 5 minutes. The Black Widow Hatchlings (24-25) on the slopes east of the cemetery drop it about one time in six, so mix them in while you wait. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Mor'Ladim|r, a level 35 elite skeleton, walks the cemetery: watch for him.

Wranglers Net and Disarm, Windchasers heal, Stormers throw Jumping Lightning: pull one at a time. Respawn about five minutes.

You have 10 minutes. They enrage below 30% health and the Warriors disarm; back in 5 minutes.

The cauldron wants 8 of each charm, 24 in all, and each exile drops its charm about one kill in three, so plan on some 70 kills. Burning Exiles (fire) by the Circle of West Binding in the north-west, north-west of Refuge Pointe; Thundering Exiles (air) by the Circle of Outer Binding south-east of Refuge Pointe, casting Lightning Bolt from 40 yards; Cresting Exiles (water) by the Circle of East Binding, north-west of Hammerfall, with Frost Nova. About a dozen of each, back in under 7 minutes. The charms trade and sell on the auction house; using one banishes another kind of exile for a while (Burning on Thundering, Thundering on Cresting, Cresting on Burning).

Cresting Charm: 8 (|cOXP_LOOT_Cresting Charm|r, from Cresting Exiles)

The Burning Exiles (level 38-39), fire elementals at the Circle of West Binding in western Arathi Highlands, drop the coal about one time in three. The guide waits for level 37 first: below it they hit too hard to solo. They resist fire: Shadow Bolt and Corruption. The Cresting Charms from the Cresting Exiles near Hammerfall finish one off once you have hurt it. Make a |cOXP_LOOT_Soul Shard|r with Drain Soul on the way.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jennea Cannon|r at the top of the Wizard's Sanctum, Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Mage Quarter|r, sends you back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r; Bink in Ironforge gives the same quest.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Deino|r, one of Orgrimmar's mage trainers in |cOXP_PICK_Darkbriar Lodge|r, sends you back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r; |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Anastasia Hartwell|r in the Undercity and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ursyn Ghull|r in Thunder Bluff give the same quest.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r's cottage is deep in the marsh west of Theramore, just north of the Stonemaul Ruins; come in from the west road, the elites roam its east side.

The Burning Blade Summoners (level 38-39, not elite) work the Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, east of Shadowprey Village, and every one carries an |cOXP_LOOT_Infernal Orb|r. They cast Shadow Bolt from 40 yards, keep an imp at their side and run for help at low health; Nether Maidens patrol the pillared ruin beside them, so pull with care. Horde mages: one more summoner stands alone in western Mulgore, south-west of Thunder Bluff.

Back at |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r's. Hand in the orb now; The Exorcism waits for level 38. Kill the critters around the cottage first: they join the fight. Accepting The Exorcism starts a 3 minute timer, and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r calls the |cOXP_ENEMY_Demon of the Orb|r out in her garden: a level 40 elite that resists many spells, roots and slows. Grouping up is encouraged: a mage of 40 may need help or potions, at about 45 it is soloable. You can pull it from range from the dock. The timer keeps running after it dies, so hand the quest in straight away. If time runs out, abandon the quest and take it again; she calls the demon again.
Kill Demon of the Orb: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Demon of the Orb|r (elite, 40))

Uldaman is a dungeon in the northern Badlands: a group of five, from level 40 here. Go in by the rear entrance, a cave in Dustwind Gulch south-east of the main entrance (elite dragons fly nearby): the |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Obsidian Sentinel|r (level 42 elite) stands just past the first door. At 80, 60, 40 and 20 percent it breaks off an |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Obsidian Shard|r, an elite too; while a shard lives, both reflect targeted spells, so use area spells and your wand on them. A solo trick: step out through the nearby zone line each time a shard appears; the Sentinel heals but keeps shrinking. It always drops the power source, and takes 2 hours to come back.
Obsidian Power Source: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Obsidian Power Source|r: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Obsidian Sentinel|r)

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r. Accepting Mana Surges opens a rift beside her cottage and starts a 10 minute timer: twelve Mana Surges (level 40, Shock and Lightning Bolt) come out about four at a time. Attacking one does not pull the rest. Standing at the edge of the field draws them all; the tree south-west of it is out of their reach but in your spell range. Kill twelve and hand in before the timer runs out.
Turn in Celestial Power (Celestial Power: the |cOXP_LOOT_Celestial Orb|r (off-hand) or the |cOXP_LOOT_Celestial Stave|r)

At 40 the mage trainers who send you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jennea Cannon|r, Bink, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Anastasia Hartwell|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Deino|r) also have Tabetha's Task, a quest any class can do. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r then wants the Tiara of the Deep from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r, a level 46 elite naga in Zul'Farrak, the troll dungeon in north-western Tanaris: a group of five, level 44-54. The reward window shows the |cOXP_LOOT_Spellshifter Rod|r and the |cOXP_LOOT_Gemshale Pauldrons|r.
Tiara of the Deep in Zul'Farrak

Zul'Farrak, the troll dungeon in north-western Tanaris, needs a group of five; the guide waits for level 44. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r is one of the bosses by the sacred pool, and the tiara always drops.
Tiara of the Deep: 1 (Tiara of the Deep: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r, Zul'Farrak)

Mannoroc Coven fills south-central Desolace, east of Shadowprey Village. The Burning Blade Summoners (level 38-39, warlocks with imps) carry the |cOXP_LOOT_Infernal Orb|r every time. For the spirit, bring your demon to low health with your damage over time, then channel the ruby or the emerald on it and keep channelling while it dies, as with Drain Soul: the gem does no damage of its own. The ruby works on the coven's felhounds: the two Mana Eaters (37-38) in the north, and the Mage Hunters (38) and Ley Hunters (39) further south. The emerald works on the Lesser Infernals (36-37, sixteen of them, fire-resistant).
Infernal Orb: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Infernal Orb|r, from the Burning Blade Summoners)
Imprisoned Felhound Spirit: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Imprisoned Felhound Spirit|r, from a |cOXP_ENEMY_Mana Eater|r, |cOXP_ENEMY_Mage Hunter|r or |cOXP_ENEMY_Ley Hunter|r)
Imprisoned Infernal Spirit: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Imprisoned Infernal Spirit|r, from a |cOXP_ENEMY_Lesser Infernal|r)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r lives at her farm in the middle of Dustwallow Marsh, south of the road from the Barrens and south-west of Theramore; a spirit healer stands beside it. Deadmire, a level 45 crocolisk, patrols the creeks just north-east. Hand in the orb now; Cleansing waits for level 38. Before you accept it, clear the spiders and crocolisks around her paddock. Accepting starts a 3-minute timer: she walks to the paddock and lets the |cOXP_ENEMY_Demon of the Orb|r out. It is elite (level 40): grouping up is encouraged; a warlock of about 40 can solo it with Fear or Banish and damage over time, a level 38 one brings a friend. The timer keeps running after the kill, so hand in at once. If time runs out, abandon the quest and take it from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r again.

Cast Teleport: Moonglade. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Loganaar|r stands in Nighthaven; your class trainer (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Turak Runetotem|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Mathrengyl Bearwalker|r or Theridran in Stormwind) offers the same quest.
Fly to Gadgetzan, ride west to the long ramp down into Un'Goro Crater: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r camps at its foot, in the south-east corner of the crater.

Eight of each. The Gorishi Wasps and Stingers (level 51-52) in and around the Slithering Scar, the hive in the south-west of the crater, drop a sting about one kill in seven; the wasps share spawn points with the other bugs, so kill whatever stands near you to make room for more wasps (respawn five minutes). The bugs' Silithid Pox makes you take more physical damage for 30 minutes; Workers call for help when hurt. The Bloodpetal Sprouts grow all over the crater (around Marshal's Refuge and the western half): open them, about every other one gives a |cOXP_LOOT_Bloodcap|r, back in three to five minutes.

Any |cOXP_ENEMY_Devilsaur|r counts, the Ironhide and Tyrant Devilsaurs too. They are elite (level 54-55), hit with Mighty Blow and outrun travel form. Grouping up is encouraged, but a druid can do it alone: Hibernate or Entangling Roots it from range, stab it with the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Barb|r (the barb does not break Hibernate), then leave. The credit counts the moment the barb lands, even if you die after. The arrow points at the plain Devilsaurs of the west and north; an |cOXP_ENEMY_Ironhide Devilsaur|r roams the middle of the crater's south, nearer |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r.
Kill Devilsaur: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Devilsaur|r: stab it with the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Barb|r)

A five-player dungeon: needs a group of five, about level 50-55. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and ride north. The Temple of Atal'Hakkar stands in the middle of the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows: climb the stairs on the ruin's south side, dive into the flooded hall, swim down through it and follow the stairs and passages down to the portal. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Atal'alarion|r (level 50 elite, Sweeping Slam and Ground Tremor) only appears when the six serpent statues on the balcony ring above the altar pit are clicked in order: South, North, South-west, South-east, North-west, North-east (each turns green when right; a wrong order fails). Clear the trash by each statue and the pit below first; jumping down into the water is the quick way down, but a knockback near the edge can kill. The |cOXP_LOOT_Putrid Vine|r always drops.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r in the south-east corner of Un'Goro Crater.
Turn in A Better Ingredient (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r: the old item choice may be gone, count on the experience)

At 50 any Alliance hunter trainer offers it: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ulfir Ironbeard|r in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Dwarven District|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Olmin Burningbeard|r in Ironforge's |cOXP_PICK_Hall of Arms|r or Dorion in Darnassus' Cenarion Enclave.
At 50 any Horde hunter trainer offers it: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ormak Grimshot|r in Orgrimmar's |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Honor|r or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Holt Thunderhorn|r on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r lives on a raised spot on the cliffs at the north-east rim of the Ruins of Eldarath, west-central Azshara. Keep to the high ridges around the ruins: the pit below does not lead up to him. Alliance: fly to Talrendis Point; Horde: fly to Valormok, a short ride west of him.

goals.name: Talrendis Point
goals.text: Get the Talrendis Point flight path

You need two Perfect Courser Antlers. Mosshoof Coursers (level 52-53, deer) graze all over Azshara and drop one about one kill in twelve, so expect two dozen kills. Good herds: north of the Thalassian Base Camp in the north, and the hills north-east and south-east of Valormok; the Lake Mennar area also has elite giants and dragonkin. They Enrage at 30% health. Coursers share spawn points with the Thunderhead hippogryphs: if none are around, kill the hippogryphs and coursers may spawn instead. Respawn is about five and a half minutes.
Perfect Courser Antler: 2 (|cOXP_LOOT_Perfect Courser Antler|r, from Mosshoof Coursers)

You need six |cOXP_LOOT_Wavethrasher Scales|r. Wavethrashers (three-headed sea beasts) live along Azshara's coasts, mostly underwater: the Young Wavethrashers (level 51-52) of the north-east shore drop a scale about one kill in three, the Wavethrashers (52-53) of the east coast by the Tower of Eldara about as often (a few walk the beach there), the Great Wavethrashers (53-54) of the south-east shore about one in seven. Track Beasts does not show them; fight them where you can breathe, and bring water breathing if you can. Elite sharks swim the deeper water.

Morphaz is an elite green drake (level 52) inside the Sunken Temple, a five-player dungeon: needs a group of five. The temple stands in the Pool of Tears in eastern Swamp of Sorrows: climb its outer steps, dive into the flooded hall and follow the stairs down to the entrance. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep or Darkshire and ride on. He is not there when you arrive: first kill the six troll guardians on the platforms around the upper ring, which opens the way down to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Jammal'an's death brings out two drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe (pull them one at a time); when both are dead, Morphaz and Hazzas appear together and cannot be split. Clear the dragonkin around the pit first, because they call for help. Morphaz uses Acid Breath and Wing Flap. The tooth always drops. Warriors in the group may want the same run for the voodoo feathers of the balcony trolls.
Tooth of Morphaz: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Tooth of Morphaz|r, inside the Sunken Temple)

In Classic Ogtinc let you choose the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Eye|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Tooth|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Hunting Spear|r here. Forever's change notes say the choice is gone, though its quest page still lists three unnamed rewards: look at the reward window before you hand in.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Maginor Dumas|r, the Master Mage, stands in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Mage Quarter|r; Dink in Ironforge gives the same quest.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Uthel'nay|r, one of Orgrimmar's mage trainers in |cOXP_PICK_Darkbriar Lodge|r, gives it; so do |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Pierce Shackleton|r in the Undercity and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Shymm|r in Thunder Bluff.

Fly to Talrendis Point (Alliance) or Valormok (Horde). |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r camps below his master's tower, a short way east of Valormok: from the fork of Azshara's main road at the Ruins of Eldarath, head straight north to the cliffs. Get off your mount before he teleports you up, or the teleport may not take you. A trail with no enemies climbs to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Xylem|r at the top of the tower; an attendant at the top sends you back down, as often as you like.
Accept Magic Dust (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Xylem|r, in the tower)

The blood elves hold the Thalassian Base Camp on the hills of north-eastern Azshara. Blood Elf Surveyors (51-52, Fire Nova up close) and Reclaimers (52-53, Fireball, and they heal and Renew each other) each drop the dust about one time in four; they spot you from far off, so pull at the edges. They come back after 5 1/2 minutes.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r, who teleports you up to the tower.

The Spitelash Sirens (level 50-52) walk the ruins and beaches around the Ruins of Eldarath and the bay east of Valormok, often three together, and a few stand inside the Temple of Zin-Malor; each drops a coral about one time in four. The Spitelash Screamers look almost the same but never drop it. Killing the other naga there makes more Sirens appear in their spots. |cOXP_ENEMY_Lingering Highborne|r ghosts wander the ruins: watch your back.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r and up to the tower.

The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the Sunken Temple, lies in the Pool of Tears: climb the steps into the sunken building, swim down through it and follow the passage down to the portal. A group of five, level 50-54. Morphaz is not waiting when you arrive. First kill the six troll guardians (elites of 50-52) on the platforms around the upper ring; that opens the way down (the left-hand ramp from the entrance) to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogom the Wretched|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Once Jammal'an dies, two green drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe, come out and patrol the pit: pull them one at a time. When both are dead, Morphaz (level 52 elite, Acid Breath and Wing Flap) and Hazzas appear together and cannot be split, so fight both. The shard always drops. Hunters, Priests and Rogues of 50 need Morphaz too: a group of them shares one clear.

Back to Azshara, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r and the tower. Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic offered the |cOXP_LOOT_Arcane Crystal Pendant|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Fire Ruby|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Glacial Spike|r, and Forever's notes say the choice may be gone.

At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker|r, the paladin trainer in the Cathedral of Light, sends you to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brandur Ironhammer|r in Ironforge gives the same quest.

At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brandur Ironhammer|r, the paladin trainer in the |cOXP_PICK_Mystic Ward|r, sends you to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker|r in Stormwind gives the same quest.

Chillwind Camp is the Alliance camp at the south end of the Western Plaguelands, north of the Alterac foothills. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Commander Ashlam Valorfist|r commands it; |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Argent Officer Pureheart|r stands in the same camp.

The Scourge drop no Scourgestones unless you wear an Argent Dawn Commission. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Argent Officer Pureheart|r gives you one through her quest, Argent Dawn Commission, which you hand in straight away (if you already have one from Light's Hope Chapel, wear that). Equip it in a trinket slot: it shows as a buff that never runs out. Keep it on until you have 20 stones.
Accept Argent Dawn Commission (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Argent Officer Pureheart|r: Argent Dawn Commission)
Turn in Argent Dawn Commission (the Argent Dawn Commission trinket: equip it)

Kill the Scourge of the Western Plaguelands with the Commission on: skeletons, ghouls and cultists (level 50-58) drop a |cOXP_LOOT_Minion's Scourgestone|r about two kills in five. Sorrow Hill, just east of Chillwind Camp around Uther's Tomb, is the closest farm. Avoid the Flesh Golems that patrol the fields; Skeletal Guardians cast Cone of Cold and Arcane Explosion up close, Dark Summoners run for help at low health.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_High Priest Thel'danis|r keeps watch at Uther's Tomb on Sorrow Hill, east of the camp. He turns your 20 stones into one |cOXP_LOOT_Inert Scourgestone|r: keep it.
Back to Chillwind Camp. Ashlam needs the voodoo of the Sunken Temple's trolls for the stone.

The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the Sunken Temple, lies in the Pool of Tears in eastern Swamp of Sorrows: go up the ruin's stairs, dive into the flooded hall and follow the stairs down to the portal. It is a dungeon for a group of five at about 50-55. Six elite troll minibosses (level 51-52) stand on the balconies around the temple's great round room, each behind a pack of elites on its side path. Each drops its feather every time: Gasher and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zul'Lor|r the Amber, Hukku and Mijan the Blue, Zolo and Loro the Green; you need all six. Hukku calls guardians and throws Shadow Bolt Volleys, Mijan heals: kill them first.
Amber Voodoo Feather: 2 (|cOXP_LOOT_Amber Voodoo Feather|r x2: Gasher, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zul'Lor|r)
Blue Voodoo Feather: 2 (|cOXP_LOOT_Blue Voodoo Feather|r x2: Hukku, Mijan)
Green Voodoo Feather: 2 (|cOXP_LOOT_Green Voodoo Feather|r x2: Zolo, Loro)

Back to Ashlam in Chillwind Camp: he forges the |cOXP_LOOT_Holy Mightstone|r. Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic also offered the |cOXP_LOOT_Chivalrous Signet|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Lightforged Blade|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Sanctified Orb|r, and Forever's notes say that choice may be gone. Use the stone before a fight against undead (Stratholme, Scholomance): it lasts ten minutes and is gone after one use.
Turn in Forging the Mightstone (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Commander Ashlam Valorfist|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Holy Mightstone|r)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r, a furbolg, lives on the clifftop north-east of the Ruins of Eldarath. Alliance: fly to Talrendis Point; Horde: fly to Valormok. Ride east and leave the road at the fork before the ruins, then follow the northern cliff edge east to him: the naga ruins and the beach below are walled in by cliffs with no way up.

Mosshoof Coursers (level 52-53, not elite) graze all over Azshara, thickest north-east of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r and south of the mountains; about one in three drops a |cOXP_LOOT_Healthy Courser Gland|r, so plan on a dozen kills for four. They enrage at 30% health: finish them fast. Killing them costs no Cenarion Circle reputation. Keep any |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r you loot.
Turn in Of Coursers We Know

Carrying an |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r already? It counts at once. Otherwise any undead may drop one, rarely: the |cOXP_ENEMY_Lingering Highborne|r (level 48) in the Ruins of Eldarath below |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r's cliff drop it about one kill in ten, the highborne ghosts on Azshara's border with Ashenvale (level 45-46) a little less, the Anguished and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Suffering Highborne|r in Winterspring (54-55) about one in eight. The Auction House is usually quicker.
Turn in The Ichor of Undeath

Morphaz is a level 52 elite green dragon inside the Sunken Temple, a five-player dungeon: bring a group of five (a level 60 group clears it with ease). Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and ride north. The temple stands in the middle of the Pool of Tears: climb the steps on its south side, swim down through the flooded hall and take the stairs to the portal. Inside, Morphaz only appears late: kill the six troll minibosses on the upper balconies, then |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r below them; that wakes the drakes Weaver and Dreamscythe in the Pit of Sacrifice, and killing both brings Morphaz and Hazzas. The pair patrols together and cannot be split: pull them into a hallway and have the tank face them away from the group (breath and a knockback). Loot him in a party, not a raid group: the blood always drops.
Blood of Morphaz: 1 (Blood of Morphaz: the Sunken Temple entrance)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Greta Mosshoof|r is at the Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood. Horde: fly to Bloodvenom Post and ride south-east; Alliance: fly to Astranaar in Ashenvale and ride north into Felwood. She takes the blood for experience and gold. Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic let you pick |cOXP_LOOT_Blessed Prayer Beads|r, |cOXP_LOOT_Circle of Hope|r or Woestave, and Forever's notes say that choice may be gone.
At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Osborne the Night Man|r in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Old Town|r has it; so do Syurna in Darnassus and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hulfdan Blackbeard|r in Ironforge.
At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ormok|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r has it; so does |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Miles Dexter|r in the Undercity's |cOXP_PICK_Rogues' Quarter|r.

Ravenholdt Manor hides in the hills east of Tarren Mill. Horde fly to Tarren Mill, Alliance to Southshore. The trail starts behind the plateau north of Durnholde Keep, climbs into the hills and runs through a small tunnel into the Alterac Mountains; Lord Jorach is inside the manor. Do not attack anyone at the manor: lost Ravenholdt reputation makes him refuse to speak to you.

Alliance fly to Talrendis Point, Horde to Valormok. Only the level 50-51 Timbermaw Shamans in the furbolg hills of northern Azshara carry the bag (the level 47-49 furbolgs further south do not): about one kill in thirty drops it. Pick Pocket them instead and you lose no Timbermaw reputation; if you are Unfriendly or better with Timbermaw Hold, mark them At War in your reputation panel first. They cast Lightning Bolt and Lightning Cloud, heal each other and run at low health.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r, camped below the cliffs just east of Valormok, teleports you up (dismount first); a trail leads to Xylem's tower.

The Forest Oozes (level 52-53, Diseased Slime up close) drop a fragment four times in five: the biggest group, seven of them, is in the Bitter Reaches hills of north-eastern Azshara, four more south-east of Valormok. Pick their pockets before the kill for an extra fragment or two. Killing the Mistwing Ravagers and hippogryphs that share their spots makes more oozes appear.

Morphaz, a level 52 elite green drake, lives deep in the Sunken Temple: a group of five, level 50-54. The temple stands in the Pool of Tears; climb into the sunken building, swim down through it and follow the passage to the portal. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep and ride on. He is not there when you arrive: first kill the six troll guardians (elites of 50-52) on the platforms around the upper ring, which opens the way down (the left-hand ramp from the entrance) to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Jammal'an's death brings out two drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe; when both are dead, Morphaz and Hazzas appear together and fight as a pair. Their Acid Breath is nature damage: nature protection potions help; poisons and Blind do not work on them. The key always drops. Hunters, Priests and Mages of 50 need Morphaz too: one clear serves them all.
Azure Key: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Azure Key|r: Morphaz, inside the temple)

Quicker: buy one at the Auction House. You need it for the trainer's An Imp's Request or for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Impsy|r's own Hot and Itchy, the same errand: whichever you hold.

Hand him the trainer's An Imp's Request with the cloth. Next he wants ten |cOXP_LOOT_Rotting Wood|r and four |cOXP_LOOT_Bloodvenom Essence|r.

The six troll guardians (level 51-52, elite) stand on the balconies around the central pit, each with adds; each drops his feather every time: Gasher and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zul'Lor|r the Amber, Hukku and Mijan the Blue, Zolo and Loro the Green. The Legashi satyrs (level 51-53) hold the Legash Encampment on Azshara's northern coast. Every kind drops the essence three times in four; the satyrs burn mana and the Hellcallers rain fire, so pull them singly.

Jaedenar lies just south of Bloodvenom Post, west of the road. The guide waits for level 53 first: its Legionnaires are 55. Of its two caves, Shadow Hold is the northern one, further up the hill; the other has no Legionnaires. Shadow Hold's tunnels run north under the hills, and the Jaedenar Legionnaires (level 55) stand in its deeper halls, from the first ramps on toward |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Lord Banehollow|r's chamber; they Uppercut anyone in melee. Three kills in four give the essence, but only about eleven spawn: clear your way in and wait out a five-minute respawn if you must. The cultists of Jaedenar and Shadow Hold are all hostile.

The Felguard Sentries (level 54) walk around the The Dark Portal in the south of the Blasted Lands, each with a felhunter. Leave the level 57 Servants of Razelikh alone: they cannot be killed without their own quest.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Impsy|r. He hands you the |cOXP_LOOT_Fel Fire|r: keep it, it wakes the infernal |cOXP_ENEMY_Kroshius|r.

|cOXP_ENEMY_Kroshius|r' remains lie in Shatter Scar Vale, the burnt crater north of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Niby the Almighty|r: follow the road north from his camp; the remains lie a little east of it. Use the |cOXP_LOOT_Fel Fire|r beside them and wait for him to rise. |cOXP_ENEMY_Kroshius|r is elite (level 55): grouping up is encouraged; a warlock of 55 or more can solo him with Fear and damage over time, or with Enslave Demon, but fire spells do nothing to him and he knocks you back. If you die he heals to full; he rises again three minutes after he dies. An elite infernal patrols the pool south of the remains: pull |cOXP_ENEMY_Kroshius|r away from it. He always drops his core. Lost the |cOXP_LOOT_Fel Fire|r? Abandon the quest and take it again from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Impsy|r.

Horde: fly to Stonard. Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and ride north through the pass. High-level beasts roam the way.

Seven Helboars (level 52-53, not elite) roam the north-west of the Blasted Lands, south-west of Nethergarde Keep; some stand near the ogres on the mountainside by the road. They charge from 25 yards and cast Fire Nova. They share spawn points with the Felbeasts and scorpids: if no boars are around, kill those and boars may appear instead. Back in 5 minutes.

The Shadowsworn camp around the mouth of the Serpent's Coil cave, south of Nethergarde Keep on the way to the Dark Portal. You need 20 Adepts (level 52-53, they leech blood and heal hurt allies: kill them first), 10 Cultists (51-52, they throw from range, so close in) and 20 Thugs (52-53, Thrash and Kick). Thugs can run short before the others: kill every Shadowsworn you pass.

You need two feathers of each colour from the six Atal'ai troll guardians (level 51-52, elite) on the Sunken Temple's balcony, who hold the barrier in front of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r: Gasher and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zul'Lor|r drop the amber, Hukku and Mijan the blue, Zolo and Loro the green, every kill; each player on the quest loots their own set. The Sunken Temple is a five-player dungeon: needs a group of five. It lies in the Pool of Tears in eastern Swamp of Sorrows: climb the temple's outer steps, dive into the flooded hall and follow the stairs down to the entrance. Inside, reach the balcony by the stairs or the path on the right, not the spiral stairs. Hukku calls guardians and casts Shadow Bolt Volley and Curse of Blood; Mijan heals the others (Renew, a |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Healing Ward|r, Healing Wave below half health): kill her or her ward fast; |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zul'Lor|r cleaves.

Target him from about 50 yards and fire the |cOXP_LOOT_Flare Gun|r twice, then walk up in front of him and /salute. In any other order he attacks. Lost the |cOXP_LOOT_Flare Gun|r? Keep |cOXP_LOOT_Fizzule's Whistle|r in your bags and use it on him every time you come near, or he turns hostile. |cOXP_ENEMY_Foreman Silixiz|r (level 22) walks by the tower: hug the wall, stealth up behind him and Pick Pocket the key. Killing him does not give it; if his pockets are empty, kill him and wait 4 1/2 minutes for him to come back.

Inside, floor by floor (everything comes back after 4 1/2 minutes): the Mutated Venture Co. Drones (level 25) on the ground floor die to one Ambush with a dagger; the Patrollers on the second floor take half their health from a one-point Rupture; the Lookouts on the open third floor from a one-point Eviscerate. |cOXP_ENEMY_Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix|r waits on the top floor: a level 23 elite, back 10 minutes after a kill. Open with Ambush (about half his health), then Gouge, Evasion, a healing potion and |cOXP_LOOT_Thistle Tea|r; a friend makes it easy. One head per kill. Then pick |cOXP_PICK_Gallywix's Lockbox|r beside him for the cache: it poisons you with the Touch of Zanzil, which weakens your stealth and agility until |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Serge Hinott|r cures it.
Gallywix's Head: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Gallywix's Head|r: |cOXP_ENEMY_Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix|r (elite))
Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture|r: |cOXP_PICK_Gallywix's Lockbox|r)

Fly back to Orgrimmar (Ratchet or the Crossroads; dying at the tower and taking the spirit healer's way back to the Crossroads is quicker). Keep |cOXP_LOOT_Silixiz's Tower Key|r afterwards. Before you leave the Cleft, buy |cOXP_LOOT_Dust of Decay|r and Empty Vials from Rekkul: once Hinott teaches Poisons, each batch of Instant Poison takes one of each.
Turn in Mission: Possible But Not Probable (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Shenthul|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Recipe: Thistle Tea|r)

Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to the Undercity and follow the road south through Silverpine Forest into Hillsbrad, to Tarren Mill. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Serge Hinott|r works in the building next to the flight path, beside |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Apothecary Lydon|r, a wagon outside. If you lost the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture, abandon and retake from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Shenthul|r. Stay beside him for about a minute while he brews the cure; if it never finishes, abandon and retake from him. Then open Poisons from your spellbook to make Instant Poison from Rekkul's dust and vials, and use it on your weapon.

goals.name: Tarren Mill
goals.text: Get the Tarren Mill flight path
Finish Hinott's Assistance: Cure Completed (Wait for the cure)
Turn in Hinott's Assistance (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Serge Hinott|r: Poisons)
Use Hinott's Oil (|cOXP_LOOT_Hinott's Oil|r: clears the Touch of Zanzil)
At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Searn Firewarder|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Wisdom|r sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r in the Barrens. (Swart in Razor Hill gives the same letter: carry either.)

At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Xanis Flameweaver|r, a shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r in the Barrens. (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Narm Skychaser|r in Bloodhoof Village gives the same letter: carry either.)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r is not in Ratchet: take the small coast road south from Ratchet past the pirate camp and over a low hill; her fishing hut, with a shark strung up outside, stands by the water before the pirate ship. If you reach the ship you went too far.
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Searn Firewarder|r's letter)
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Xanis Flameweaver|r' letter)
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: Swart's letter)
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: Narm's letter)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brine|r lives in the southern Barrens, south of Camp Taurajo: her hut sits on a hilltop of Blackthorn Ridge with a spinning windmill beside it, and the way up is the ridge by the lone tree. Quilboar camp all around the hill; Stormhides, thunderhawks and hyenas roam the plains on the way.

The muddy pond below |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brine|r's hut. Step right into the puddle before you use the |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Brown Waterskin|r (too far away and it refuses). Filling it calls a hostile |cOXP_ENEMY_Razormane Pathfinder|r (level 20): kill it, and watch for the quilboar hunter by the pond, who may start shooting afterwards.
Use |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Brown Waterskin|r (|cOXP_LOOT_Empty Brown Waterskin|r, standing in the puddle)

The |cOXP_PICK_Spring Well|r stands in the middle of Tarren Mill, just outside the church. From the Barrens: the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal Glades, then south past the Undercity and through Silverpine Forest (or fly once you have the Tarren Mill flight path). Hillsbrad is contested: Alliance players may attack. Stand beside the well and use the |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Red Waterskin|r.
Use |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Red Waterskin|r (|cOXP_LOOT_Empty Red Waterskin|r, beside the well)

The right fountain stands in a ring of standing stones on the island of the small green lake south of Astranaar, west of Lake Mystral (not the island in Lake Mystral itself). From the Barrens take the road north through the Mor'shan Rampart and on west. Water elementals and walking treants guard the lake and root you in place; an elite |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Wandering Protector|r roams Ashenvale and can pass close by. Use the |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Blue Waterskin|r beside the fountain.
Use |cOXP_LOOT_Empty Blue Waterskin|r (|cOXP_LOOT_Empty Blue Waterskin|r, beside the fountain)
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brine|r. She gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Vial of Purest Water|r for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r.
Accept Call of Water (the |cOXP_LOOT_Vial of Purest Water|r, for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r hands you the |cOXP_LOOT_Water Sapta|r and the |cOXP_LOOT_Remaining Drops of Purest Water|r: take everything she offers before you leave for Silverpine, or you will be back for more.
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: your |cOXP_LOOT_Water Sapta|r)
Only if the Water Sapta is gone from your bags: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r gives you another.
Turn in Water Sapta (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: a new Water Sapta)

Fly to the Sepulcher. The shrine lies in a hollow just south-west of it: go round the back of the crypt to the thick tree between the two hills, hop past it onto the rocks and drop west down the slope to the pool (each drop costs a little health). Drink the |cOXP_LOOT_Water Sapta|r beside the tall standing stone by the pool: several water elementals appear, and only the corrupt one near the middle can be attacked (Tab picks it). The |cOXP_ENEMY_Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water|r is level 22 and casts Frost Shock and Frost Nova; if someone just killed it, it is back in about three minutes. Its bracers always drop.
Use |cOXP_LOOT_Water Sapta|r (|cOXP_LOOT_Water Sapta|r, beside the standing stone)

Click the |cOXP_PICK_Brazier of Everfount|r to place the bracers and the drops. A few seconds later the pure |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Minor Manifestation of Water|r rises on the stone in the middle of the pool: speak to it while the Sapta Sight lasts (drink again by the stone if it has worn off). It gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Shard of Water|r for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r. Gone before you could speak to it? Back at |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r ask for Call of Water (a fresh Water Sapta for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tiev Mordune|r, who stands just west of the shrine): hand it to Tiev, stay close while he calls the spirit back, then speak to it.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r south of Ratchet. Keep the |cOXP_LOOT_Water Totem|r in your bags for good: every water totem needs it.
Turn in Call of Water (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Islen Waterseer|r: Healing Stream Totem and your |cOXP_LOOT_Water Totem|r)

At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r, in the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r under the |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Strength|r, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Cazul|r a few steps away. Two trainers start these demons, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r here and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r in the Undercity, and you can take only one; this guide follows whichever Devourer of Souls you took. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Cazul|r offers both of Orgrimmar's branches: take both.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zankaja|r lives in a hut up on the cliffs on the west side of the city, above the |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Strength|r: climb the wind rider tower, cross the bridge at its top to the west and turn right off it. She sends you to the Crossroads.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Magar|r keeps |cOXP_PICK_Magar's Cloth Goods|r on the main street east of the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r. He asks you to look for his mate Krilge in Ashenvale.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gazrog|r waits in front of the inn at the Crossroads. He sends you on to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ken'zigla|r at Malaka'jin, in Stonetalon Mountains.

Take the road west from the Crossroads into Stonetalon Mountains and, just past the border, the faint trail up to the left (south): Malaka'jin cannot be reached from the main road. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ken'zigla|r hands you her draught for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Grunt Logmar|r.
Turn in News of Dogran (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ken'zigla|r, Malaka'jin)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Grunt Logmar|r stands at Camp Taurajo, south down the road from the Crossroads. He sends you north to the quilboar camp where Dogran is held: the camp with two huts side by side, north-west of a decoy camp whose huts stand apart. A rare level 22 elite quilboar sometimes guards the huts: send your voidwalker in, sacrifice it if you must, and talk to Dogran. He gives you a pendant for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r. Keep it.
Turn in Ken'zigla's Draught (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Grunt Logmar|r, Camp Taurajo)

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r with the pendant. He hands you |cOXP_LOOT_Dogran's Pendant|r: take it across the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Neeru Fireblade|r's tent, stand on the purple circle and use it. Summon your voidwalker first and let it tank: the succubus (level 20, not elite) charms and lashes; keep your damage over time on her. If she wins, use the pendant again. Keep the pendant: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r takes it back.
Use Dogran's Pendant (|cOXP_LOOT_Dogran's Pendant|r, on the circle in Neeru's tent)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r: Summon Succubus)

Fallen Sky Lake lies in southern Ashenvale, south-west of Splintertree Post. The Shadethicket Stone Movers and Bark Rippers (level 25-27) around the lake drop the |cOXP_LOOT_Withered Scarf|r about one time in twenty, and the lone |cOXP_ENEMY_Shadethicket Oracle|r (30) can drop it too: plan on a good number of kills, so the guide waits for level 24 first (Forever made this quest level 27); with the succubus already bound you can leave it for your 20s leveling in Ashenvale. They respawn in five minutes.

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r with the scarf, then use the |cOXP_LOOT_Withered Scarf|r on the same circle in Neeru's tent and defeat the incubus it calls (level 20, not elite) with your voidwalker tanking. Keep the scarf: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r takes it back.
Turn in Wish You Were Here
Kill Summoned Incubus: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Summoned Incubus|r, at the circle in Neeru's tent)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r: Summon Incubus)

|cOXP_PICK_The Undercity|r's version, for warlocks who took |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r's Devourer of Souls instead of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Gan'rul Bloodeye|r's. At 20 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r, in the |cOXP_PICK_Magic Quarter|r, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Godrick Farsan|r close by. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Godrick Farsan|r shows you an image of each quarry and offers both branches: take both.
Accept Hearts of the Pure (the succubus)
Accept Hearts of the Lovers (the incubus)

|cOXP_ENEMY_Avelina Lilly|r (level 22) works as a tailor for the Dalaran wizards at Ambermill, in eastern Silverpine: the wizards around her are hostile. |cOXP_ENEMY_Dalin Forgewright|r (level 20, not elite) patrols near the Greymane Wall in the far south. Both are Alliance-friendly humans: attacking them can flag you for PvP. Each drops her or his heart.

|cOXP_ENEMY_Corma Villard|r (level 22, not elite; Comar in older records) wanders the north of the Wetlands just past the Thandol Span, to the right as you come off the bridge. From the Undercity head through Hillsbrad and Arathi Highlands, where the mobs are 30 and up. Attacking her flags you for PvP.

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r with Dalin's and |cOXP_ENEMY_Corma Villard|r's hearts. He hands you the |cOXP_LOOT_Pure Hearts|r: go down to the summoning circle below him, stand on it and use them. Summon your voidwalker first and keep the fight on the circle, or the guards may kill her and the kill does not count. If she wins, use the hearts again; keep them, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r takes them back.
Turn in Hearts of the Pure
Use Pure Hearts (|cOXP_LOOT_Pure Hearts|r, on the circle below |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r: Summon Succubus)

|cOXP_ENEMY_Isaac Pearson|r (level 22) works in Ratchet, on the Barrens coast, at one of two spots in town: take the zeppelin to Durotar and head south, or fly from Orgrimmar. He is an Alliance-friendly human: attacking him can flag you for PvP.

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r with the lovers' hearts, then place the |cOXP_LOOT_Lovers' Hearts|r on the same circle and defeat the incubus they call (level 20, not elite; it can charm you). Keep the hearts: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r takes them back.
Turn in Hearts of the Lovers
Kill Summoned Incubus: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Summoned Incubus|r, at the circle below |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r)
Turn in The Binding (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Carendin Halgar|r: Summon Incubus)
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sorek|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Honor|r sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ruga Ragetotem|r in Camp Taurajo.
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torm Ragetotem|r, the warrior trainer of Thunder Bluff, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ruga Ragetotem|r in Camp Taurajo.
At 20, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Baltus Fowler|r, a warrior trainer of the Undercity, sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ruga Ragetotem|r in Camp Taurajo.
Fly to Camp Taurajo. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ruga Ragetotem|r stands in the hut with the leatherworking and tailoring trainers.
Accept Trial at the Field of Giants
Trial at the Field of Giants

You have 30 minutes, and each |cOXP_LOOT_Twitching Antenna|r rots 15 minutes after you loot it, so take the quest only when ready (logging out does not stop the clock). The Silithid Mounds dot the Field of Giants south of Camp Taurajo; every silithid drops an antenna. Creepers (level 20-21) and Grubs are the easiest: Swarmers (21-22) call small swarms and Creepers lay eggs that hatch adds. The eastern part of the field has plenty of Creepers. |cOXP_LOOT_Ruga's Bulwark|r, a shield, is the reward.
Twitching Antenna: 5 (|cOXP_LOOT_Twitching Antenna|r, from the silithid)
Turn in Trial at the Field of Giants (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ruga Ragetotem|r: |cOXP_LOOT_Ruga's Bulwark|r)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Thun'grim Firegaze|r's hut sits on top of Thorn Hill, east of the Crossroads: climb the broad ridge on the north or east side. Brutal Armor is a level 30 quest; take it now and gather on the way. |cOXP_LOOT_Thun'grim's Instructions|r list where each material comes from.

You need 15 Smoky Iron Ingots. The Windshear Mine lies at the east end of Windshear Crag, east of Sun Rock Retreat; every Windshear kobold (level 19-23) drops an ingot four kills in five. Stonecutters, Geomancers and Overlords run for help when low; Geomancers cast Frostbolt.
Smoky Iron Ingot: 15 (|cOXP_LOOT_Smoky Iron Ingot|r, from the Windshear kobolds)

You need 10 |cOXP_LOOT_Powdered Azurite|r. The guide waits for level 25 first. The Hillsbrad Miners (level 26-27) work the mine in the hills west of Southshore and drop the azurite four kills in five; they fight in Defensive Stance, sunder your armor and run for help at 30% health. Fly to Tarren Mill and head south-west.
Powdered Azurite: 10 (|cOXP_LOOT_Powdered Azurite|r, from the Hillsbrad Miners)

Roogug is an elite quilboar (level 28) inside Razorfen Kraul, the dungeon at the south end of the Barrens; a five-player dungeon: needs a group of five, his guards come with him. The guide waits for level 26 first. Inside take the left path at the first fork, cross the vine bridge over the pig pens, go past the room with the big cauldron: he waits in the room on the right. He casts Lightning Bolt and calls Earth Rumblers. The vial always drops.
Vial of Phlogiston: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Vial of Phlogiston|r, from Roogug)
You need 10 Iron Bars. Miners smelt them from |cOXP_LOOT_Iron Ore|r (one ore a bar, Smelt Iron at Mining 125); everyone else buys them at the auction house in Orgrimmar.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Thun'grim Firegaze|r on Thorn Hill. Brutal Hauberk is the first piece; he then sends you to three crafters, one per piece: take all three.
Accept Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets
Accept Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm
Accept Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ula'elek|r is in Sen'jin Village on the Durotar coast. He wants 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves.
Turn in Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets

The satyrs of Satyrnaar, north-east of Splintertree Post (Xavian, level 28-30), and the Felmusk satyrs north-west of the post (25-27) drop a hoof four kills in five. A Xavian satyr at 15% health may cast Gift of the Xavian and heal to full: finish it fast or stun it. Hellcallers throw Fireballs from 40 yards; Felmusk satyrs reek in melee and run for help at 15%.
Turn in Satyr Hooves (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ula'elek|r, Sen'jin Village)
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Orm Stonehoof|r works on Thunder Bluff's lowest level, close to the blacksmith.
Turn in Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

The |cOXP_ENEMY_Chimaera Matriarch|r (level 28, not elite, larger than the young ones around her) roams the south edge of the Charred Vale in south-west Stonetalon, near the road to Desolace. She is the only one: she returns 5 minutes after dying and drops the |cOXP_LOOT_Galvanized Horn|r four kills in five. She spits Corrosive Poison from 30 yards.
Galvanized Horn: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Galvanized Horn|r, from the |cOXP_ENEMY_Chimaera Matriarch|r)
Take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal Glades; |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Velora Nitely|r works in the Undercity's |cOXP_PICK_Trade Quarter|r. She wants 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones.
Turn in Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

The Dragonmaw orcs (level 26-30) camp in the middle of the Wetlands; from Hammerfall in Arathi head south over the Thandol Span (Menethil Harbor is Alliance). With Dragonmaw Shinbones from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Velora Nitely|r in your log, every Raider, Swamprunner, Centurion, Shadowwarder and Bonewarder drops a |cOXP_LOOT_Dragonmaw Shinbone|r (without the quest they drop none): right-click it to test it, and about one in four comes out sturdy, the rest break, so expect 30 or more kills for 8. You can test while moving or fighting. The orcs run for help at 15%; Raiders net you, Centurions shield-bash, Shadowwarders cast Shadow Bolt, Bonewarders raise skeletons.
Dragonmaw Shinbone: 1 (from the Dragonmaw orcs: right-click to test it)

The |cOXP_PICK_Dead Drop|r is a chest in a house just outside Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine, south of Shadowfang Keep. Open it and read C's note: the job has to be done alone, out of any group.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Veenix|r, a goblin friendly to both factions, stands among the Venture Co. in the Windshear Crag, east Stonetalon, a short way north-east of Sun Rock Retreat. Horde fly to Sun Rock Retreat; Alliance to Stonetalon Peak. He wants a |cOXP_LOOT_Venture Co. Work Order|r before he hands over explosives: the Venture Co. Loggers (level 18) working around him carry them in their pockets. Stealth up behind one and Pick Pocket it; killing them does not give it.

Go in alone and use the |cOXP_LOOT_Breaching Charge|r at the courtyard gate. Players also report a freed prisoner opening the courtyard door for you: if you die while he is opening it, stay dead until it is open; it stays open once you release. If you know Vanish, bring |cOXP_LOOT_Flash Powder|r and check its cooldown before entering; keep it ready for a failed approach. Pickpocket the sister in the dining hall for the |cOXP_LOOT_Sister's Half-Key|r, then the brother in the room reached by turning right at the top of the stairs for the |cOXP_LOOT_Brother's Half-Key|r (a level 20 rogue without Vanish may need ranks in Master of Deception to reach the second one unseen). Combine them somewhere safe: this breaks stealth. Free a bag slot first: opening the chest with full bags can use up the key without giving the horn. Return to the courtyard stables and use the combined key on the chest for the horn. Stay clear of the nearby elites; the minimum quest level does not guarantee a safe approach.
Horn of Xelthos: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Horn of Xelthos|r, inside Shadowfang Keep)

Place the horn in the |cOXP_PICK_Dead Drop|r near Pyrewood. The payment may not appear immediately: check a capital mailbox for C's follow-up letter on your next planned city visit, then return to this chest for the reward quest. Do not repeat the dungeon just because the payment is not yet offered.
Turn in The Horn of Xelthos
Turn in The Horn of Xelthos (|cOXP_LOOT_Pyrewood Signet Ring|r)

At 24 any capital's rogue trainer (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Master Mathias Shaw|r or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Osborne the Night Man|r in Stormwind, Gest or Ormok in Orgrimmar, and the others) has an |cOXP_LOOT_Elegant Letter|r from |cOXP_ENEMY_Ravenholdt|r for you: ask for it in their talk window. Open it: the quest gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Seal of Ravenholdt|r for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Fahrad|r. Learn Detect Traps from your trainer first if you have not; the way in is a test of it.

Horde fly to Tarren Mill, Alliance to Southshore. The trail to the manor is hard to see: it starts behind the plateau north of Durnholde Keep, east of Tarren Mill, climbs into the hills and bends twice to a small tunnel. A chest sits in the tunnel: do not open it. Cast Detect Traps near it and walk up close; that is the Rite of Cunning (it comes back after 5 minutes). Opening the chest calls Milton, an elite rogue of about level 32. Through the tunnel lies Ravenholdt Manor: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Fahrad|r is upstairs inside. Do not attack anyone at the manor: it costs |cOXP_ENEMY_Ravenholdt|r reputation.
Kill Ravenholdt: 1 (Rite of Cunning: Detect Traps beside the tunnel chest)

|cOXP_ENEMY_Lord Tomas|r is inside Durnholde Keep, the Syndicate fortress south of the manor; he can stand in any of fifteen spots in the keep, so search. Quick and quiet, says |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Myrokos Silentform|r. Pick the pockets of the level 20-21 Syndicate Rogues, Shadow Mages and Watchmen on your way: they carry Syndicate Emblems for the guards' repeatable reputation quest.
Turn in Syndicate Emblems (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ravenholdt Guard|r: one emblem each time, 100 reputation)

In your mid 30s |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Myrokos Silentform|r has two more jobs; take both. Barton leads a Syndicate scouting party at Strahnbrad, in the east of the Alterac Mountains, inside one of the houses with stealthed Syndicate around him. Pick his pocket for the report and do not kill him: he does not drop it. If you are lower than him he sees through stealth; Master of Deception helps, or Distract him, Vanish and come in from behind. Pick Pocket can miss several times in a row.

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Myrokos Silentform|r; the report sends you after the Perenolde heirlooms. Two towers stand among the Ruins of Alterac, in the middle of the Alterac Mountains, held by ogres: the shield lies in the northern tower, the sword in the southern one, which elite ogres ring and watch from far off. Stay stealthed; nothing guards the heirlooms inside.
Turn in What's the Big Idea?
Royal Aegis of Perenolde: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Royal Aegis of Perenolde|r, in the northern tower)
Blade of House Perenolde: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Blade of House Perenolde|r, in the southern tower)

Stromgarde Keep in western Arathi is a Syndicate stronghold; to get in you need a uniform. Northfold Manor, in north-western Arathi, is held by Syndicate Highwaymen, Pathstalkers and Mercenaries (level 30-32): find the |cOXP_PICK_Syndicate Footlocker|r there and take the uniform; that ends A Way In.
Turn in A Way In (|cOXP_PICK_Syndicate Footlocker|r, Northfold Manor)
Accept Master of Disguise (Master of Disguise: the |cOXP_LOOT_Syndicate Uniform|r)

At 80, 60, 40 and 20 percent it breaks off an |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Obsidian Shard|r, an elite too; while a shard lives, both reflect targeted spells, so use area spells and your wand on them. A solo trick: step out through the nearby zone line each time a shard appears; the Sentinel heals but keeps shrinking. It always drops the power source, and takes 2 hours to come back.
Obsidian Power Source: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Obsidian Power Source|r: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Obsidian Sentinel|r)

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r. Accepting Mana Surges opens a rift beside her cottage and starts a 10 minute timer: twelve Mana Surges (level 40, Shock and Lightning Bolt) come out about four at a time. Attacking one does not pull the rest. Standing at the edge of the field draws them all; the tree south-west of it is out of their reach but in your spell range. Kill twelve and hand in before the timer runs out.
Turn in Celestial Power (Celestial Power: the |cOXP_LOOT_Celestial Orb|r (off-hand) or the |cOXP_LOOT_Celestial Stave|r)

At 40 the mage trainers who send you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jennea Cannon|r, Bink, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Anastasia Hartwell|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Deino|r) also have Tabetha's Task, a quest any class can do. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r then wants the Tiara of the Deep from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r, a level 46 elite naga in Zul'Farrak, the troll dungeon in north-western Tanaris: a group of five, level 44-54. The reward window shows the |cOXP_LOOT_Spellshifter Rod|r and the |cOXP_LOOT_Gemshale Pauldrons|r.
Tiara of the Deep in Zul'Farrak

Zul'Farrak, the troll dungeon in north-western Tanaris, needs a group of five; the guide waits for level 44. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r is one of the bosses by the sacred pool, and the tiara always drops.
Tiara of the Deep: 1 (Tiara of the Deep: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hydromancer Velratha|r, Zul'Farrak)
Turn in Tiara of the Deep
Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil (Stormwind)

Accept Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil

At 35 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Zevrost|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r sends you to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Menara Voidrender|r in Ratchet.
Accept Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil (Undercity)

Accept Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Menara Voidrender|r and her two acolytes stand in |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Strahad Farsan|r's tower on the hill above Ratchet.
