Pick one acolyte: you can take only one of their quests. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Acolyte Wytula|r's felhound path ends with the Orb or |cOXP_LOOT_Staff of Dar'Orahil|r, the shadow versions; |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Acolyte Magaz|r's infernal path with the Orb or |cOXP_LOOT_Staff of Noh'Orahil|r, much the same items on the fire side. Most warlocks lean on shadow, but compare the four in their tooltips first. The guide follows the one you take. Keep the ruby or the emerald: it is handed back.
Accept Shard of a Felhound (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Acolyte Wytula|r: she gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Felhas Ruby|r)
Accept Shard of an Infernal (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Acolyte Magaz|r: he gives you the |cOXP_LOOT_Infus Emerald|r)

Mannoroc Coven fills south-central Desolace, east of Shadowprey Village. The Burning Blade Summoners (level 38-39, warlocks with imps) carry the |cOXP_LOOT_Infernal Orb|r every time. For the spirit, bring your demon to low health with your damage over time, then channel the ruby or the emerald on it and keep channelling while it dies, as with Drain Soul: the gem does no damage of its own. The ruby works on the coven's felhounds: the two Mana Eaters (37-38) in the north, and the Mage Hunters (38) and Ley Hunters (39) further south. The emerald works on the Lesser Infernals (36-37, sixteen of them, fire-resistant).
Infernal Orb: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Infernal Orb|r, from the Burning Blade Summoners)
Imprisoned Felhound Spirit: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Imprisoned Felhound Spirit|r, from a |cOXP_ENEMY_Mana Eater|r, |cOXP_ENEMY_Mage Hunter|r or |cOXP_ENEMY_Ley Hunter|r)
Imprisoned Infernal Spirit: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Imprisoned Infernal Spirit|r, from a |cOXP_ENEMY_Lesser Infernal|r)
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Menara Voidrender|r in the tower above Ratchet with the spirit and the gem first: her orb follows from it.
Turn in Shard of a Felhound
Turn in Shard of an Infernal

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r lives at her farm in the middle of Dustwallow Marsh, south of the road from the Barrens and south-west of Theramore; a spirit healer stands beside it. Deadmire, a level 45 crocolisk, patrols the creeks just north-east. Hand in the orb now; Cleansing waits for level 38. Before you accept it, clear the spiders and crocolisks around her paddock. Accepting starts a 3-minute timer: she walks to the paddock and lets the |cOXP_ENEMY_Demon of the Orb|r out. It is elite (level 40): grouping up is encouraged; a warlock of about 40 can solo it with Fear or Banish and damage over time, a level 38 one brings a friend. The timer keeps running after the kill, so hand in at once. If time runs out, abandon the quest and take it from |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Tabetha|r again.
Turn in Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
Accept Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
Turn in Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil

Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Menara Voidrender|r in the tower above Ratchet with the cleansed orb. On the felhound path, accept her last quest and wait beside her while she completes the |cOXP_LOOT_Orb of Dar'Orahil|r (do not attack her: the quest log calls it a kill), then speak to her again and pick the off-hand orb or the staff.
Turn in Returning the Cleansed Orb

On the infernal path, accept her last quest and wait beside |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Menara Voidrender|r while she completes the |cOXP_LOOT_Orb of Noh'Orahil|r, then speak to her again and pick the off-hand orb or the staff.

Cast Teleport: Moonglade. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Loganaar|r stands in Nighthaven; your class trainer (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Turak Runetotem|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Mathrengyl Bearwalker|r or Theridran in Stormwind) offers the same quest.
Fly to Gadgetzan, ride west to the long ramp down into Un'Goro Crater: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r camps at its foot, in the south-east corner of the crater.

Eight of each. The Gorishi Wasps and Stingers (level 51-52) in and around the Slithering Scar, the hive in the south-west of the crater, drop a sting about one kill in seven; the wasps share spawn points with the other bugs, so kill whatever stands near you to make room for more wasps (respawn five minutes). The bugs' Silithid Pox makes you take more physical damage for 30 minutes; Workers call for help when hurt. The Bloodpetal Sprouts grow all over the crater (around Marshal's Refuge and the western half): open them, about every other one gives a |cOXP_LOOT_Bloodcap|r, back in three to five minutes.

Any |cOXP_ENEMY_Devilsaur|r counts, the Ironhide and Tyrant Devilsaurs too. They are elite (level 54-55), hit with Mighty Blow and outrun travel form. Grouping up is encouraged, but a druid can do it alone: Hibernate or Entangling Roots it from range, stab it with the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Barb|r (the barb does not break Hibernate), then leave. The credit counts the moment the barb lands, even if you die after. The arrow points at the plain Devilsaurs of the west and north; an |cOXP_ENEMY_Ironhide Devilsaur|r roams the middle of the crater's south, nearer |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r.
Kill Devilsaur: 1 (|cOXP_ENEMY_Devilsaur|r: stab it with the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Barb|r)

A five-player dungeon: needs a group of five, about level 50-55. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and ride north. The Temple of Atal'Hakkar stands in the middle of the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows: climb the stairs on the ruin's south side, dive into the flooded hall, swim down through it and follow the stairs and passages down to the portal. |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Atal'alarion|r (level 50 elite, Sweeping Slam and Ground Tremor) only appears when the six serpent statues on the balcony ring above the altar pit are clicked in order: South, North, South-west, South-east, North-west, North-east (each turns green when right; a wrong order fails). Clear the trash by each statue and the pit below first; jumping down into the water is the quick way down, but a knockback near the edge can kill. The |cOXP_LOOT_Putrid Vine|r always drops.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r in the south-east corner of Un'Goro Crater.
Turn in A Better Ingredient (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Torwa Pathfinder|r: the old item choice may be gone, count on the experience)

At 50 any Alliance hunter trainer offers it: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ulfir Ironbeard|r in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Dwarven District|r, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Olmin Burningbeard|r in Ironforge's |cOXP_PICK_Hall of Arms|r or Dorion in Darnassus' Cenarion Enclave.
At 50 any Horde hunter trainer offers it: |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ormak Grimshot|r in Orgrimmar's |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Honor|r or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Holt Thunderhorn|r on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r lives on a raised spot on the cliffs at the north-east rim of the Ruins of Eldarath, west-central Azshara. Keep to the high ridges around the ruins: the pit below does not lead up to him. Alliance: fly to Talrendis Point; Horde: fly to Valormok, a short ride west of him.

goals.text: Get the Talrendis Point flight path

You need two Perfect Courser Antlers. Mosshoof Coursers (level 52-53, deer) graze all over Azshara and drop one about one kill in twelve, so expect two dozen kills. Good herds: north of the Thalassian Base Camp in the north, and the hills north-east and south-east of Valormok; the Lake Mennar area also has elite giants and dragonkin. They Enrage at 30% health. Coursers share spawn points with the Thunderhead hippogryphs: if none are around, kill the hippogryphs and coursers may spawn instead. Respawn is about five and a half minutes.
Perfect Courser Antler: 2 (|cOXP_LOOT_Perfect Courser Antler|r, from Mosshoof Coursers)

You need six |cOXP_LOOT_Wavethrasher Scales|r. Wavethrashers (three-headed sea beasts) live along Azshara's coasts, mostly underwater: the Young Wavethrashers (level 51-52) of the north-east shore drop a scale about one kill in three, the Wavethrashers (52-53) of the east coast by the Tower of Eldara about as often (a few walk the beach there), the Great Wavethrashers (53-54) of the south-east shore about one in seven. Track Beasts does not show them; fight them where you can breathe, and bring water breathing if you can. Elite sharks swim the deeper water.

Morphaz is an elite green drake (level 52) inside the Sunken Temple, a five-player dungeon: needs a group of five. The temple stands in the Pool of Tears in eastern Swamp of Sorrows: climb its outer steps, dive into the flooded hall and follow the stairs down to the entrance. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep or Darkshire and ride on. He is not there when you arrive: first kill the six troll guardians on the platforms around the upper ring, which opens the way down to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Jammal'an's death brings out two drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe (pull them one at a time); when both are dead, Morphaz and Hazzas appear together and cannot be split. Clear the dragonkin around the pit first, because they call for help. Morphaz uses Acid Breath and Wing Flap. The tooth always drops. Warriors in the group may want the same run for the voodoo feathers of the balcony trolls.
Tooth of Morphaz: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Tooth of Morphaz|r, inside the Sunken Temple)

In Classic Ogtinc let you choose the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Eye|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Devilsaur Tooth|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Hunting Spear|r here. Forever's change notes say the choice is gone, though its quest page still lists three unnamed rewards: look at the reward window before you hand in.
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Maginor Dumas|r, the Master Mage, stands in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Mage Quarter|r; Dink in Ironforge gives the same quest.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Uthel'nay|r, one of Orgrimmar's mage trainers in |cOXP_PICK_Darkbriar Lodge|r, gives it; so do |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Pierce Shackleton|r in the Undercity and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Shymm|r in Thunder Bluff.

Fly to Talrendis Point (Alliance) or Valormok (Horde). |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r camps below his master's tower, a short way east of Valormok: from the fork of Azshara's main road at the Ruins of Eldarath, head straight north to the cliffs. Get off your mount before he teleports you up, or the teleport may not take you. A trail with no enemies climbs to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Xylem|r at the top of the tower; an attendant at the top sends you back down, as often as you like.
Accept Magic Dust (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Archmage Xylem|r, in the tower)

The blood elves hold the Thalassian Base Camp on the hills of north-eastern Azshara. Blood Elf Surveyors (51-52, Fire Nova up close) and Reclaimers (52-53, Fireball, and they heal and Renew each other) each drop the dust about one time in four; they spot you from far off, so pull at the edges. They come back after 5 1/2 minutes.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r, who teleports you up to the tower.

The Spitelash Sirens (level 50-52) walk the ruins and beaches around the Ruins of Eldarath and the bay east of Valormok, often three together, and a few stand inside the Temple of Zin-Malor; each drops a coral about one time in four. The Spitelash Screamers look almost the same but never drop it. Killing the other naga there makes more Sirens appear in their spots. |cOXP_ENEMY_Lingering Highborne|r ghosts wander the ruins: watch your back.
Back to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r and up to the tower.

The Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the Sunken Temple, lies in the Pool of Tears: climb the steps into the sunken building, swim down through it and follow the passage down to the portal. A group of five, level 50-54. Morphaz is not waiting when you arrive. First kill the six troll guardians (elites of 50-52) on the platforms around the upper ring; that opens the way down (the left-hand ramp from the entrance) to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogom the Wretched|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Once Jammal'an dies, two green drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe, come out and patrol the pit: pull them one at a time. When both are dead, Morphaz (level 52 elite, Acid Breath and Wing Flap) and Hazzas appear together and cannot be split, so fight both. The shard always drops. Hunters, Priests and Rogues of 50 need Morphaz too: a group of them shares one clear.

Back to Azshara, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r and the tower. Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic offered the |cOXP_LOOT_Arcane Crystal Pendant|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Fire Ruby|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Glacial Spike|r, and Forever's notes say the choice may be gone.

At 50 in Ironforge, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_High Priest Rohan|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Hall of Mysteries|r (|cOXP_PICK_Mystic Ward|r) offers Cenarion Aid. Before you leave a city, buy an |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r at the Auction House (a few silver): the third quest asks for one and it drops rarely.

At 50, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Brother Joshua|r at the altar of Stormwind's Cathedral of Light offers Cenarion Aid (|cOXP_FRIENDLY_High Priest Rohan|r in Ironforge has it too). Before you leave, buy an |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r at the Auction House in the |cOXP_PICK_Trade District|r (a few silver): the third quest asks for one and it drops rarely.

At 50, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ur'kyo|r in Orgrimmar's |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Spirits|r offers Cenarion Aid. Before you leave, buy an |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r at the Auction House (a few silver): the third quest asks for one and it drops rarely.

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r, a furbolg, lives on the clifftop north-east of the Ruins of Eldarath. Alliance: fly to Talrendis Point; Horde: fly to Valormok. Ride east and leave the road at the fork before the ruins, then follow the northern cliff edge east to him: the naga ruins and the beach below are walled in by cliffs with no way up.

goals.text: Get the Talrendis Point flight path

Mosshoof Coursers (level 52-53, not elite) graze all over Azshara, thickest north-east of |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r and south of the mountains; about one in three drops a |cOXP_LOOT_Healthy Courser Gland|r, so plan on a dozen kills for four. They enrage at 30% health: finish them fast. Killing them costs no Cenarion Circle reputation. Keep any |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r you loot.
Turn in Of Coursers We Know

Carrying an |cOXP_LOOT_Ichor of Undeath|r already? It counts at once. Otherwise any undead may drop one, rarely: the |cOXP_ENEMY_Lingering Highborne|r (level 48) in the Ruins of Eldarath below |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ogtinc|r's cliff drop it about one kill in ten, the highborne ghosts on Azshara's border with Ashenvale (level 45-46) a little less, the Anguished and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Suffering Highborne|r in Winterspring (54-55) about one in eight. The Auction House is usually quicker.
Turn in The Ichor of Undeath

Morphaz is a level 52 elite green dragon inside the Sunken Temple, a five-player dungeon: bring a group of five (a level 60 group clears it with ease). Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and ride north. The temple stands in the middle of the Pool of Tears: climb the steps on its south side, swim down through the flooded hall and take the stairs to the portal. Inside, Morphaz only appears late: kill the six troll minibosses on the upper balconies, then |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r below them; that wakes the drakes Weaver and Dreamscythe in the Pit of Sacrifice, and killing both brings Morphaz and Hazzas. The pair patrols together and cannot be split: pull them into a hallway and have the tank face them away from the group (breath and a knockback). Loot him in a party, not a raid group: the blood always drops.
Blood of Morphaz: 1 (Blood of Morphaz: the Sunken Temple entrance)

|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Greta Mosshoof|r is at the Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood. Horde: fly to Bloodvenom Post and ride south-east; Alliance: fly to Astranaar in Ashenvale and ride north into Felwood. She takes the blood for experience and gold. Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic let you pick |cOXP_LOOT_Blessed Prayer Beads|r, |cOXP_LOOT_Circle of Hope|r or Woestave, and Forever's notes say that choice may be gone.
At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Osborne the Night Man|r in Stormwind's |cOXP_PICK_Old Town|r has it; so do Syurna in Darnassus and |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Hulfdan Blackbeard|r in Ironforge.
At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Ormok|r in the |cOXP_PICK_Cleft of Shadow|r has it; so does |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Miles Dexter|r in the Undercity's |cOXP_PICK_Rogues' Quarter|r.

Ravenholdt Manor hides in the hills east of Tarren Mill. Horde fly to Tarren Mill, Alliance to Southshore. The trail starts behind the plateau north of Durnholde Keep, climbs into the hills and runs through a small tunnel into the Alterac Mountains; Lord Jorach is inside the manor. Do not attack anyone at the manor: lost Ravenholdt reputation makes him refuse to speak to you.

Alliance fly to Talrendis Point, Horde to Valormok. Only the level 50-51 Timbermaw Shamans in the furbolg hills of northern Azshara carry the bag (the level 47-49 furbolgs further south do not): about one kill in thirty drops it. Pick Pocket them instead and you lose no Timbermaw reputation; if you are Unfriendly or better with Timbermaw Hold, mark them At War in your reputation panel first. They cast Lightning Bolt and Lightning Cloud, heal each other and run at low health.

goals.text: Get the Talrendis Point flight path
Sealed Azure Bag: 1 (Sealed Azure Bag: |cOXP_ENEMY_Timbermaw Shaman|r)
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sanath Lim-yo|r, camped below the cliffs just east of Valormok, teleports you up (dismount first); a trail leads to Xylem's tower.

The Forest Oozes (level 52-53, Diseased Slime up close) drop a fragment four times in five: the biggest group, seven of them, is in the Bitter Reaches hills of north-eastern Azshara, four more south-east of Valormok. Pick their pockets before the kill for an extra fragment or two. Killing the Mistwing Ravagers and hippogryphs that share their spots makes more oozes appear.

Morphaz, a level 52 elite green drake, lives deep in the Sunken Temple: a group of five, level 50-54. The temple stands in the Pool of Tears; climb into the sunken building, swim down through it and follow the passage to the portal. Horde: fly to Stonard; Alliance: fly to Nethergarde Keep and ride on. He is not there when you arrive: first kill the six troll guardians (elites of 50-52) on the platforms around the upper ring, which opens the way down (the left-hand ramp from the entrance) to |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Jammal'an the Prophet|r in the Pit of Sacrifice. Jammal'an's death brings out two drakes, Weaver and Dreamscythe; when both are dead, Morphaz and Hazzas appear together and fight as a pair. Their Acid Breath is nature damage: nature protection potions help; poisons and Blind do not work on them. The key always drops. Hunters, Priests and Mages of 50 need Morphaz too: one clear serves them all.
Azure Key: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Azure Key|r: Morphaz, inside the temple)

Look at the reward window before you hand in: Classic offered the |cOXP_LOOT_Duskbat Drape|r, the |cOXP_LOOT_Ebon Mask|r or the |cOXP_LOOT_Whisperwalk Boots|r, and Forever's notes say the choice may be gone.
At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Sagorne Creststrider|r, the shaman trainer in the |cOXP_PICK_Valley of Wisdom|r, asks for the four elements for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bath'rah the Windwatcher|r.

At 50 |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Beram Skychaser|r, a shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, asks for the four elements for |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bath'rah the Windwatcher|r. Skyborne: Forever's quest page lists Elemental Mastery and Spirit Totem for Orcs, Tauren and Trolls only; if |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Beram Skychaser|r has nothing for you, |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bath'rah the Windwatcher|r's own Mastering the Elements is open to every Horde race, but Spirit Totem after it may still turn you away.

One each of |cOXP_LOOT_Elemental Air|r, Fire, Earth and Water; all four trade, so the auction house is quickest. To farm them, Arathi Highlands has the exiles near Refuge Pointe (level 38-39, about one kill in eight to ten, respawn under seven minutes): Thundering Exiles south-east of it (air), Rumbling Exiles south-west (earth), Burning Exiles far to the north-west (fire), and the |cOXP_ENEMY_Summoned Guardian|r far to the south-west (water, about one in seven). Water comes easier from the Patches of Elemental Water in Azshara (two in five) or |cOXP_FRIENDLY_Seeker Aqualon|r by Lakeshire in Redridge.
Elemental Water: 1 (|cOXP_LOOT_Elemental Water|r: the |cOXP_ENEMY_Summoned Guardian|r, or Azshara's water patches)
|cOXP_FRIENDLY_Bath'rah the Windwatcher|r camps in the ruins of the east of Alterac Mountains: from Tarren Mill follow the river east of town north into the hills.

Eight of each. Fly or ride to the Bulwark and on to the west edge of the Western Plaguelands, north-west of Chillwind Camp: the Venom Mist Lurkers (level 50-51, they poison) give the |cOXP_LOOT_Bloodshot Spider Eye|r and the Diseased Black Bears (level 51-52, Infected Wound) the |cOXP_LOOT_Thick Black Claw|r, one kill in five each; the two Carrion Vultures there drop either. The bigger Diseased Grizzlies and Plague Lurkers further east almost never drop them. A few bears and lurkers also roam south-east of Brill in Tirisfal.

A five-player dungeon: needs a group of five, about level 50-55. Fly to Stonard and ride east.
